name: APT Mirror
description: Points Ubuntu's default apt sources (archive.ubuntu.com, security.ubuntu.com) at a different mirror.

mirror.description: The mirror base URL to replace archive.ubuntu.com with (e.g. 'http://jp.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu'). Leave empty to make no change.

include_security.description: Also replace security.ubuntu.com with 'mirror'. Most Ubuntu mirrors, including regional ones, don't carry security updates, so this defaults to false and leaves security.ubuntu.com pointed at Canonical's own server.
